title: J1 E3 repeated D4 transition-kernel completeness analysis
question: Do the present source-backed and project-defined components jointly specify a normalized causal repeated D4 transition kernel and a private accumulated logical scorer?
answer: No. The result is a verified localized negative: K1 and K3 are missing, K2 is localized-only, and K4 is partial.

K1_physical_state_evolution.supported: Static D4 observations can be sampled conditional on a supplied physical chain, and externally supplied projector labels can be chained deterministically.
K1_physical_state_evolution.missing: There is no normalized law for the next hidden D4 state conditional on the previous state, a data-fault increment, and the applied correction.

K2_public_measurement_kernel.supported: The E1 local report rows and generic categorical rows normalize exactly, and perfect-report limits are defined.
K2_public_measurement_kernel.missing: Those channels condition on externally supplied truth; they do not define a joint multisite, cross-round distribution of true D4 outcomes.

K3_action_conditioned_postflux_kernel.supported: E2 verifies exact action/report binding, temporal order, and deterministic composition when a physical post-flux report is supplied.
K3_action_conditioned_postflux_kernel.missing: No current component evolves the physical residual state under the flux action and then generates a normalized physical charge/vacuum report from that updated state.

K4_private_logical_scorer.supported: One completed spatial cycle can be scored privately using the ground-state-relative homology criterion.
K4_private_logical_scorer.missing: There is no canonical accumulated spacetime residual across repeated faults and two-stage corrections, nor a derivation that the single-shot criterion is sufficient for it.

causal_dependency.why_other_factors_do_not_close_the_kerne: Normalized report noise in K2 cannot create the missing true-state distribution, and the partial K4 scorer cannot define the preceding physical transition.

model_comparison.what_it_adds: A declared finite hidden D4 state and an explicit normalized project transition law.
model_comparison.benefit: Smallest implementable extension and compatible with bounded exact enumeration.
model_comparison.cost: Introduces a new physical assumption and is not a reproduction of a transition law supplied by the audited sources.

model_comparison.what_it_adds: Quantum-state memory with projector outcomes and action-conditioned Born-rule transitions.
model_comparison.benefit: Closest in semantics to the source projector description and can retain noncommuting cross-round information.
model_comparison.cost: Requires a larger mathematical state space and additional state-update definitions not currently present in the project.

model_comparison.model: ancilla or circuit-derived repeated extraction channel
model_comparison.what_it_adds: A fault map over explicit measurement and correction primitives from which the repeated transition can be derived.
model_comparison.benefit: Strongest operational grounding for measurement faults and hardware-facing schedules.
model_comparison.cost: Requires circuit/source dependencies and materially broadens scope; the audited sources do not currently supply a complete D4 circuit.

decision_status.reason: All three model classes can be made internally normalized and can pass the present exact interface checks, but they make different physical assumptions and require different dependencies and compute budgets.
choice_materially_changes: meaning of a future fault-tolerance result
decision_status.consultation_not_yet_opened: This tick completes only the registered analysis/report transition; the next contract item is the decision gate.
